results.title: Fluidized bed technology and pelleting in focus: Amandus Kahl at Powtech Technopharm
results.description: Whether fine powders for baby food, granules for the pharmaceutical industry, or pellets for chemical processing, all these products require processes that deliver a high degree of precision. At Powtech Technopharm in Nuremberg, Amandus Kahl will demonstrate how fluidized bed technology and pelleting deliver precise results in practice.
